readme.content:
Messenger automation for recipe recommendations
--

[FastAPI](https://github.com/c-azb/RecipesMessengerAuto/blob/main/main.py) application with webhooks that connect with Meta Messenger to automate messages to recommend recipes based on user inputs.

[Agent](https://github.com/c-azb/RecipesMessengerAuto/blob/main/src/recipes_agent.py) is a LangGraph graph that connects with [tools](https://github.com/c-azb/RecipesMessengerAuto/blob/main/src/tools.py) in a loop until it provides an answer. Tools available are a [vectordb search on Pinecone](https://github.com/c-azb/RecipesMessengerAuto/tree/main/vectordb_pinecone/vdb_mcp_search) for recipes (using Gemini API) and a [creative tool](https://github.com/c-azb/RecipesMessengerAuto/tree/main/src/creative_search_mcp) that calls an LLM to generate custom recipe ingredient ideas. Tools use MCP, so they are centralized and reusable for different applications.

Once the user sends a message on Meta Messenger, the agent will automatically be called and provide an answer about recipe recommendations.

from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv()

from fastapi import FastAPI,Request
from pyngrok import ngrok
import uvicorn
import requests
from os import getenv
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from src.recipes_agent import RecipesAgent,LLMs

NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN = getenv("NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN")  #https://dashboard.ngrok.com/get-started/your-authtoken
VERIFY_TOKEN = getenv('VERIFY_TOKEN')
ACCESS_TOKEN = getenv('ACCESS_TOKEN')
PHONE_NUMBER_ID = getenv('PHONE_NUMBER_ID')
APPLICATION_PORT = 5000

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    ngrok.set_auth_token(NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN)
    public_url = ngrok.connect(APPLICATION_PORT)
    print(f"Ngrok tunnel \"{public_url}\" -> 'http://127.0.0.1:{APPLICATION_PORT}'")
    yield

    ngrok.disconnect(public_url)
    print("Ngrok tunnel closed")

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)

@app.get('/')
async def root():
    return {'msg':'welcome to reipes recommendations!'}

@app.get("/webhook")
async def verify(request: Request):
    mode = request.query_params.get("hub.mode")
    token = request.query_params.get("hub.verify_token")
    challenge = request.query_params.get("hub.challenge")
    if mode == "subscribe" and token == VERIFY_TOKEN:
        return int(challenge)
    return {"status": "error"}


@app.post("/webhook")
async def webhook(request: Request):
    try:
        data = await request.json()
        message = data['entry'][0]['messaging'][0]

        sender_id = message["sender"]["id"]
        text = message["message"].get("text", "")
        try:
            response = await call_agent(text)
        except Exception as e:
            print("Error inside call_agent:", e)
            error_message = "Sorry, something went wrong while processing your request."
            send_messenger_message(sender_id, error_message)
            return {"status": "error-handled"}
        send_messenger_message(sender_id, response)
        return {"status": "ok"}
    except Exception as e:
        print("Fatal webhook error:", e)
        return {"status": "webhook-parsed-error"}

def send_messenger_message(user_id, text):
    url = "https://graph.facebook.com/v21.0/me/messages"
    params = { "access_token": ACCESS_TOKEN }
    payload = {
        "recipient": { "id": user_id },
        "message": { "text": text }
    }
    requests.post(url, params=params, json=payload)

async def call_agent(query:str):
    print(f'calling agent with query: {query}')
    recipes_agent = RecipesAgent( LLMs() )
    res= await recipes_agent.invoke_agent(query)
    return res['messages'][-1].content

    uvicorn.run("main:app", host="127.0.0.1", port=APPLICATION_PORT, reload=True)
